item.title: Ribbits
item.creator: Refresh Studios
item.description:
Experience the ultimate cozy swamp expansion! Meet a charming amphibian civilization with unique jobs and trades. Catch bugs, build custom aquariums, trap fish, or start a band with musical Ribbits! Packed with new lush blocks and adorable creatures.

Official Bedrock Edition of the Ribbits Java Mod by Refresh Studios & Bonsai Studios!
item.changelog: - Improved compatibility with third-party Vibrant Visuals packs.

faqEntries.heading: Where can I find Ribbit villages?
faqEntries.content: Ribbit villages generate in unexplored swamp biomes. Search newly generated areas of your world to find one.

faqEntries.heading: Can I use Ribbits in an existing world?
faqEntries.content: Yes! However, Ribbit villages can only appear in terrain that was not explored before activating the add-on.

faqEntries.heading: What are Amethyst Shards used for?
faqEntries.content: Many Ribbits trade their items for Amethyst Shards. Shards can also be used to relocate Ribbits and craft replacement Guidebooks.

faqEntries.heading: Can I move a Ribbit away from its village?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Bring the Ribbit to its new location, then sneak and use an Amethyst Shard on it. That location will become its new home.

faqEntries.heading: Does Ribbits work in multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Activate Ribbits on the multiplayer world or Realm, and have joining players download the required Resource Pack when prompted.

howToEntries.content:
1. Create a new world or edit an existing one. Under **Behavior Packs**, find Ribbits in **My Packs** and select **Activate**.

2. Enter the world and open the included **Ribbits Guidebook** to learn about the add-on’s creatures, items, blocks, and activities.

3. Explore an unexplored swamp biome and look for a Ribbit village. Bring some Amethyst Shards with you!

4. Meet the Ribbits, trade with their different professions, catch bugs and fish, collect decorative blocks, and join the village musicians.
